taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station Egwi, Etche LGA survey stations. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 295.88 | 0.54518 | 0.54518
2 | 798.6 | 3.5924 | 4.1376
3 | 864.62 | 2.1559 | 6.2935
4 | 1810.2 | 37.957 | 37.25
5 | 5634.2 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as HAA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station Egwi, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Report – Station Egwi, Etche LGA**

The VES interpretation at Station Egwi reveals a five-layer subsurface sequence with resistivity increasing monotonically with depth: Layer 1 (295.88 Ω·m, 0.545 m), Layer 2 (798.6 Ω·m, to 4.14 m), Layer 3 (864.62 Ω·m, to 6.29 m), Layer 4 (1810.2 Ω·m, to 37.25 m), and Layer 5 (5634.2 Ω·m, unterminated/basement-like layer).

Applying the curve-type convention to each triplet of successive resistivities (1-2-3, 2-3-4, 3-4-5), all three comparisons satisfy r1 < r2 < r3, yielding "A" for each segment. The correct curve designation is therefore AAA, which simplifies to a single-letter A-type curve, not the HAA-type listed in the file. The filed classification does not match the actual resistivity progression, as no H (decrease-then-increase) segment is present. This discrepancy should be corrected in the station's interpretation record.

{"curve_type_stated": "AAA", "label_issue_flagged": true}
